title: Tomas sails out of the port (paraphrase)

notes: Formulation B: independent re-phrasing of the ten meaning units of F02A in both languages (same events, same order, same name Tomas). 'boat' becomes 'vessel'/'Schiff', 'harbour' becomes 'port' (German 'Hafen' has no common synonym and is kept), 'catch' becomes 'haul' (German 'Fang' kept, as 'Beute' would change the meaning). No separable verbs ('ausfahren', 'auswerfen' avoided). Unit 10 'winds down' / 'geht zu Ende' is a non-separable verb phrase with the adjunct in the post-field, grammatical but slightly marked. Unit 9 reads naturally in German; units 1 and 10 read naturally in English.
